description: Unit tests for TalkDirectiveParser, validating parsing and directive extraction from textual input.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveTests
classes.description: Test suite for TalkDirectiveParser parsing functionality.

methods.name: testParsesDirectiveAndStripsLine

methods.name: testIgnoresNonDirective
methods.description: Ensures non-directive text is handled without creating a directive.

methods.name: testKeepsDirectiveLineIfNoRecognizedFields

methods.description: Validates parsing of extended directive options with various fields.

methods.description: Checks that unknown keys in directive JSON are captured.
